description: Construct unsigned non-custodial EVM calldata (`approve(spender, 0)`, selector `0x095ea7b3`) to revoke an open ERC-20 token allowance granted to a router or spender contract on any of 8 EVM networks. Read-only calldata generator: never signs or broadcasts transactions (unlimited free calls, 0% fee). Returns JSON with `network`, `to` (token contract), `spender`, `data` (68-byte hex calldata), `value` (`0x0`), and `eip5792_call` ready for wallet signing.

network.description: Target EVM chain where the ERC-20 allowance exists. Defaults to `base`.

spender.description: 42-character hexadecimal router or spender contract address (`0x...`) whose spending permission is being revoked.

token_address.description: 42-character hexadecimal ERC-20 token contract address (`0x...`) whose allowance will be reset to zero.

name: build_erc20_approval_revoke
